enabled.title: Enable wire shim
enabled.description: Fail-closed: disabling rejects anthropic-claude requests instead of sending them unrewritten.

claude_code_version.title: Claude Code version
claude_code_version.description: Version string embedded in the user-agent and cc_version billing fingerprint.

entrypoint.title: Entrypoint
entrypoint.description: cc_entrypoint billing value and user-agent entrypoint segment.

device_id.title: Device ID (optional)
device_id.description: 64 lowercase hex characters, matching the Claude account's ~/.claude.json userID. Written into metadata.user_id together with account_uuid.

account_uuid.title: Account UUID (optional)
account_uuid.description: The Claude account UUID. Must be configured together with device_id.

stainless_package_version.title: x-stainless-package-version
stainless_package_version.description: Anthropic TypeScript SDK version bundled by the pinned Claude Code release.
